items.source: Execute the given task synchronously, through direct invocation of its call() method.
items.translation: 同步执行给定的task，通过直接调用其call()方法。

items.source: Uses of TaskCallback in org.springframework.core.task
items.translation: TaskCallback 在 org.springframework.core.task 中的用法

items.source:
This package defines Spring's core TaskExecutor abstraction,
and provides SyncTaskExecutor and SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor implementations.
items.translation: 该包定义了 Spring 的核心 TaskExecutor 抽象，并提供 SyncTaskExecutor 和 SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor 实现。
